name: OrdRankBen
description: OrdRankBen is a novel benchmark for ranking tasks in NLP that incorporates structured ordinal relevance labels to capture multi-granularity relevance distinctions. It provides datasets with ordinal label distributions to enable more precise evaluation of ranking models, addressing limitations of binary and continuous relevance labels.
reputation: A new benchmark proposed in a 2025 paper and not yet known to have broad community adoption.
notes: Constructed two datasets with ordinal labels; evaluates ranking-based and large language models.
